name: enerflex
description: EnerFlex — portail de suivi de consommation multi-sites B2B (démo agents IA)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,ui -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.test: npm test -w backend && npm test -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
